entities.summary: Ramón Antonio Rosso Mieses is a Dominican professional baseball pitcher for the Rieleros de Aguascalientes of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Philadelphia Phillies. Rosso made his MLB debut in 2020.
